title: Lists, Cons Cells [H | T] & The Character List Mystery
solutionExplanation: Utilizes cons operator [H | T] for O(1) prepending, front-element pattern destructuring, and string codepoint extraction.

otpDocCards.description: Returns the head and tail of a non-empty list.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: O(1) BIF reading cons cell pointers directly.

mentalModelCheck.question: Why does appending an item with (List ++ [Item]) perform significantly worse than prepending with [Item | List]?

options.label: Because the BEAM must scan and re-allocate every cons cell in the left list from beginning to end to point to the new item
options.explanation: Lists are singly-linked. Adding to the end requires traversing and copying all N previous nodes.

options.label: Because the ++ operator triggers an operating system system call to allocate virtual memory
options.explanation: List concatenation is handled by the emulator allocator on the process heap, not an OS syscall.

options.label: Because Erlang locks the entire node whenever ++ is evaluated to prevent race conditions
options.explanation: Erlang processes have independent private heaps; no locks are involved in list concatenation.
